flowRules.labels: Usually noun + infinitive verb, two short words. object/action each contain one word; combined max 32 characters. No prose or authored line breaks. Terminal defaults: Start/Ende.
flowRules.branches: Existing downwards placement starts a branch row; subsequent steps go right.
flowRules.loops: Explicit return to an earlier reachable step. Exit and enter at the bottom; prefer a lower free grid row for the returning leaf node and distinct clear return lanes below the flow.
flowRules.overlaps: New or changed connectors must not cross node interiors. Keep other nodes in place; reject the batch if no clear route is available.

observer_note: Committed results reconstruct labels/bindings/returned node positions; they do not guarantee complete final edge geometry.
